correction: The first version of rule 3 read only the top-level unit file and treated every assignment as a name, so a drop-in, a SupplementaryGroups= entry and a DynamicUser= that a later line overrides all escaped it. Emulating systemd's drop-in merging was itself incomplete (type-wide service.d, prefix directories such as frost-.service.d, and same-basename precedence between an instance and its template), so the guard now fails closed on account keys in drop-ins and parses only unit files.
